Return only one JSON object with these fields and types: {"pattern":"string","label":"string","quote":"string or null","source_id":"string"}. pattern is one of "amended", "results", "presentation", "cash flow", read from the change: "amended" if the form ends in /A; otherwise "results" if ni changed; otherwise "presentation" if revenue or oi changed; otherwise "cash flow". label must belong to the pattern's group or be "insufficient_evidence". Groups: results = restatement_non_reliance, error_correction_revision, accounting_change_retrospective; presentation = discontinued_operations, segment_recast, income_statement_reclassification; cash flow = cash_flow_reclassification; amended = amendment_restatement, amendment_tagging_or_clerical. quote is the sentence copied verbatim from Evidence S1 that states the reason, or null when label is "insufficient_evidence". Copy source_id S1. No Markdown, no other text.
Change: filing form 10-Q, filed 2026-08-18; changed figures: oi, ni, ocf. oi for 2025-04-01..2025-06-30: -185,232 -> -10,412,000 USD; ni for 2025-04-01..2025-06-30: 1,973,286 -> -9,186,000 USD; oi for 2025-01-01..2025-12-31: -8,035,205 -> -35,719,000 USD; and 4 more change(s).
Evidence S1 (10-Q accession 0001628280-26-057508, document infq-20260630.htm):
Correction of Immaterial Errors
Subsequent to the original issuance of the Company's condensed and/or consolidated financial statements for the periods presented below, the Company identified a errors related to revenue recognition and GAAP accounting methodology for the provision of expected losses for a certain contracts. Management evaluated the error and the impact to previously issued financial statements based upon ASC 250, Accounting Changes and Error Corrections. Based on this evaluation, management has concluded that the adjustments and impact of these errors are not material to any previously issued financial statements.
Request: State why this filing changed previously reported figures.
output: {"pattern":"results","label":"error_correction_revision","quote":"Management evaluated the error and the impact to previously issued financial statements based upon ASC 250, Accounting Changes and Error Corrections.","source_id":"S1"}
